objective: Choose the architecture strategy most likely to beat the current 0.71 macro-F1 baseline on the churn-prediction dataset in train.jsonl, on a two-hour training budget.
rubric: 1. The proposed strategy fits the two-hour budget on one GPU. 2. Any claimed accuracy gain cites a specific mechanism, not a general reputation. 3. Class imbalance in the churn label is addressed explicitly. 4. A strategy with an unresolved fatal critique cannot win.

participants.stance: Argue for a tuned gradient-boosted tree ensemble over the tabular features.
Argue for a small transformer trained directly on the tabular features with feature embeddings.
Argue for stacking a gradient-boosted model with a logistic-regression meta-learner.
